Name: MythicFenix's Golden Goose for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from MythicFenix, I've updated their Golden Goose (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4432]here[/url]) to work with SVD 1.6. Credit for the original mod goes to MythicFenix.

Golden Geese live in coops and produce feathers and eggs. And yes, they can swim!

Enjoy!
